svg.title: Where the targets come from, and which count
svg.desc: Panel A: a packed window with two stories (Tom smiled. <eos> | Once upon a time). Head 1 targets are tokens[t+1], head 2 targets tokens[t+2]; a target is kept only if it is in the same document and not <pad>. Panel B: a padded row where <pad> targets are masked. Masked targets become -100 and the loss averages over counted targets only.
svg.text: <eos> belongs to the story it ends
✗ masked: crosses a story boundary, or target is <pad>
